description: This file defines a UserRepository class that manages CRUD operations for the 'users' database table, including creating users and retrieving user data by ID or email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A repository class for performing CRUD operations on the 'users' table, extending the BaseRepository base class.

methods.name: UUID create(self, email: str, full_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new user record into the database and returns the generated UUID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_by_id(self, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user record by UUID and converts it to a dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user record by email and converts it to a dictionary.
